items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I'd go down and play maybe one or two nights for Alligator

ctx.x: How do you spell that, Ponca City?

P-o-n-c-a. Ponca City. And that's the reason, you know, I ran into that stuff down there. I'd go down and play maybe one or two nights for Alligator, but then I'd have to take the bus and go down and wait and catch another bus late in the morning and come back, you know?
What were you studying at this junior college?
